title: Implement TOML peering configuration schema
description:
Define the TOML configuration schema for the transit daemon: [listen] (TCP address), [peers] (list of peer addresses for dialing), [groups] (list of groups to serve), [ipfs] (IPFS API config), [pinning] (policy rules), [gc] (schedule and policy). Implement Config struct with serde deserialization and validation. Artifact: transit/src/config.rs.

Acceptance:
- Invalid TOML exits with human-readable error naming the invalid field
- Required fields are validated on load (no panics on missing required field)
- Example config file included in transit/config.example.toml
- Unit test: parse the example config with no errors
